plan.summary: Add a REVERSE movement order that moves a vehicle one grid cell opposite its orientation without rotating it, while preserving existing board-boundary and simultaneous-collision rules.
steps: Add REVERSE to MovementOrder so turns can represent backward movement.
Add a Position operation that calculates the adjacent cell opposite a vehicle's NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, or WEST orientation.
Handle REVERSE in MovementEngine.applyOrder, retaining the vehicle's orientation and passing the resulting intention through the existing boundary and collision resolution.
Document reverse vectors, unchanged orientation, boundary behavior, and reuse of the simultaneous-movement collision rules; remove reverse movement from the out-of-scope list.
tests: Verify reversing moves one cell in the correct opposite direction for all four orientations without changing orientation.
Verify reverse movement beyond every board edge is blocked.
Verify a stationary vehicle blocks a reversing vehicle.
Verify reverse and forward movements targeting the same cell are both blocked.
Verify position swaps involving reverse movement are blocked.
Verify a reversing vehicle may enter a cell successfully vacated during the same turn.
Run the backend Maven test suite with ./mvnw test from the backend directory.
